title: idpf-issue-reviewer result
description: The JSON result one idpf-issue-reviewer instance returns for the one issue it reviewed (#3499, PRD #3493). The parent validates it with .claude/scripts/shared/lib/subagent-result.js before the issue enters the review roster; a result failing validation, an empty reply or an errored Agent call is that instance's error, never a guessed recommendation. Role contract: Reference/Agent-Architecture.md.

recommendation.description: The /review-issue Step 2d recommendation, one of its four values.

labelAssigned.description: review-finalize.js labelAssigned, verbatim. null when the label swap failed; the parent's Step 3b verdict event emits nothing for it.

reviewNumber.description: The **Reviews:** N value finalize wrote for this review.

filesToModifyWritten.description: Whether the 2a-ii (b) Files-to-modify write ran before finalize (#2891). false for an epic, which 2a-ii does not cover.
